# pip constraints for the CI provisioning venvs.
#
# Applied through PIP_CONSTRAINT, which set_env.sh exports before the platform
# hook runs, so every pip install in a platform script honours it.
#
# .github/version-pins.env fixes the *specified* packages (torch, FlagTree,
# FlagGems, FlagCX). This file fixes the ones a script installs unpinned and the
# transitive pulls that otherwise drift with the runner image -- the case the pin
# table cannot reach. Keep the two in sync: a version here must not contradict
# the pin table or a script's explicit install.
#
# Torch is pinned in version-pins.env and installed explicitly; the constraint
# keeps a transitive requirement from resolving a second, incompatible build.
torch==2.10.0

# NumPy 2.x breaks the stock CPU torch C extensions at import, and transformers
# pulls it by default. Every script that needs NumPy already asks for <2; this
# makes it hold for the transitive pull too.
numpy<2

# The range the agnostic-checks job and the hardware venvs use. 4.51 is the floor
# because that is where Qwen3 model_type support landed. 5.x is excluded because
# its TokenizersBackend rewrite breaks the slow-to-fast tokenizer conversion the
# mounted checkpoints need even with sentencepiece/tiktoken installed;
# set_env_ppu.sh carries the detail and the upstream discussion. Both ends have
# to stay pinned -- an install that leaves either open picks whichever of the two
# failure modes is currently latest on the index.
transformers>=4.51,<5
